about.title: about me
about.description:
I am a full-stack software engineer with over 8 years of experience developing scalable, high-performance systems. I have worked across sectors such as fintech, healthcare, and music technology, building efficient solutions for complex problems.

I have strong experience with Node.js, TypeScript, React, and distributed systems architecture, and I also contribute to building SaaS platforms used by thousands of users.

I value clean code, best practices, and solutions that generate real business impact, always collaborating with the team to evolve the product as a whole.
